heroBadge: DPDP Act 2023 · Zero-Knowledge Architecture · MeitY Compliant
heroDesc: Tech Sahaya is engineered so your personal documents and biometric identifiers never touch permanent disk storage. All entitlement checks run through ephemeral in-memory evaluation with transparent rule quotations.
zeroizeDetail: All ephemeral buffers, token caches, and document descriptors zeroized instantly.
boundariesDesc: You always know what enters our privacy boundary, what is strictly forbidden, and the controls you hold.
collectFoot: · Stored in isolated user session · Easily editable anytime
neverFoot: · Hardware firewall blocked · Penalized under DPDP
controlFoot: · Accessible in Privacy Center · No admin review required
pillarsDesc: Every protection backed by cryptographic proofs and code-level verification.
pipelineDesc: At no point in this 5-stage lifecycle are raw citizen credentials committed to databases.
ctaDesc: Our Data Protection Officer and Citizen Grievance Redressal desk are available under the DPDP Act 2023.
